brief: The Claude Code stack a one-person founder uses to ship like a 10-person team.

slots.title: 1. Claude Code, the engineer
slots.body: Handles full-stack coding, debugging, and refactors. You describe features; it writes production-ready code across your entire codebase.

slots.title: 2. Figma, the designer
slots.body: Design, prototype, and export assets without a design team. Component libraries keep your UI consistent and ship-ready.

slots.title: 3. Next.js, the foundation
slots.body: Full-stack React framework with SSR and API routes. One codebase handles frontend, backend, and edge functions without separate teams.

slots.title: 4. Supabase, the backend
slots.body: Postgres database, auth, and storage without backend engineers. Row-level security replaces weeks of API development.

slots.title: 5. Vercel, the pipeline
slots.body: Zero-config deployments with preview branches and analytics. Push to Git and your site ships globally in seconds.

slots.title: 6. Stripe, the revenue
slots.body: Payments, billing, and invoicing infrastructure pre-built. Integrate once and start collecting revenue immediately.

slots.headline: Start Shipping Tonight
slots.subline: One-person teams can outpace startups. Save this stack and ship your next feature today.
